name: MiseOS Repo Pet
description: A Shimeji-style terminal mascot that safely roams a repository or container filesystem and surfaces repo context without modifying files.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for filesystem behavior, character runtime changes, or write-mode support.
changePolicy.minor: Allowed for new characters, renderers, and read-only context improvements.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for bug fixes, docs, and metadata corrections.

release.cadence: manual until repository publishing is stable
release.currentStrategy: Keep package unpublished until GHCR runner and primary packages are validated.
release.nextMilestone: Publish as optional developer experience package after @mise-os/cli.

answers.what: A safe read-only terminal mascot package for MiseOS repositories.
answers.does: Walks repo context, displays Mise Orchestra characters, and helps make repository state understandable.
answers.permissions: Local filesystem read access only; no network and no writes.
answers.registry: GitHub npm registry under @mise-os after review.
answers.changed: Integrated from the uploaded repo pet patch as packages/repo-roamer with @mise-os scope normalization.
answers.safe: Safe by default because it is read-only, local, and has explicit review gates for network or write changes.
answers.agentExecutable: Yes, agents may execute it for read-only repository orientation and demos.
